title: Strengthen Product Registry versioning, lifecycle and provisional records
requirements:
- Define separate product, packaging, regulatory, item and publication statuses
- Expand history and provenance metadata and require impact assessment of changes
- Allow time-bound provisional records for emergency procurement, donations and migration, with later reconciliation
- Define decision rights per role
- Define the effect of each lifecycle status on consumers; prohibit deletion of identifiers needed for history
- Require impact analysis across consumers before major changes
- Define a complete audit profile
